feature_map: Multi-asset portfolio tracking — Stocks, Mutual Funds, Traded Bonds, F&O (equity/currency/commodity), Fixed Deposits, NPS, PMS, AIF and other asset classes in one consolidated view

Auto-import engine — reads trade files across 5,000+ formats from 700+ brokers/banks/RTAs: broker contract notes & back-office files, MF CAS (CAMS/NSDL), MF RTA files (CAMS/Karvy/Franklin), eNPS (Karvy/NSDL), PMS & AIF statements; handles PDF, Excel, HTML, CSV, TXT, DBF
Email auto-import — user sets an email forwarding rule so incoming trade files are auto-forwarded and parsed into portfolios in near real-time with zero manual effort
Performance analytics — Absolute Gain and Annualised Return (XIRR) for any asset, asset class, portfolio or portfolio group; multi-level asset-allocation insights

Capital Gains reporting in Income-Tax-Return (ITR) format — long-term, short-term & intra-day for Stocks/MF/Bonds; applies LTCG grandfathering & indexation; unrealised CG estimation; exports compatible with ClearTax, Winman, CompuTax

Live market data — live price updates for Stocks/ETFs (15-min delayed), daily MF NAV and listed-bond prices, and corporate-action updates (dividend, bonus, split, merger, demerger); historical end-of-month valuations
F&O management — track equity/currency/commodity F&O positions, import digital contract notes & trade-book files, maintain mark-to-market records, track realised/unrealised P&L

Multiple portfolios & portfolio groups — investors maintain individual portfolios and group them for consolidated family holdings; advisors keep client investments in category-wise / family-wise portfolios
Wealth-professional / multi-tenant features — provide MProfit logins to clients, client self-service portals on web & mobile, global AUM reports, white-label logo branding
Reports suite — Income, Due Dates, Transactions, Holding Period, asset allocation, and global/advanced AUM reports
Cross-platform access — Web application (MProfit Cloud) plus native Android (com.mprmobile) and iOS (id1418536415) apps
Marketing & conversion surface — features, pricing (separate Investor vs Wealth-Professional plans), import/broker search, reviews (500+), blog, referral program, buy/subscribe & login flows

priorities: 1. Canonical multi-asset data model + import parser engine — transaction ledger for Stocks/MF/Bonds/F&O/FD/NPS/PMS/AIF plus broker/RTA/CAS file ingestion (the highest-value, hardest-to-copy core)
2. Portfolio valuation & market-data layer — price/NAV feed integration, corporate-action handling, live and historical end-of-month valuations
3. Analytics engines — XIRR/absolute-gain/asset-allocation and India capital-gains (ITR format, LTCG grandfathering, indexation) reporting
4. Multi-tenant auth & advisor→client hierarchy — accounts, portfolios, portfolio groups, client provisioning, white-label branding
5. Reporting & app surfaces — web (MProfit Cloud) reports UI plus Android/iOS parity; email auto-import forwarding pipeline
6. Marketing/conversion site — Gatsby+Sanity clone (features, pricing, import search, reviews, referral, login/buy) — low effort, high polish
intel.moat: MProfit's defensibility is its proprietary import engine: it reliably parses and normalizes 5,000+ file formats from 700+ Indian brokers, banks, RTAs and PMS/AIF providers (contract notes, back-office files, MF CAS/RTA, eNPS) across PDF/Excel/HTML/CSV/TXT/DBF into one clean transaction ledger. That breadth requires continuous, labor-intensive maintenance of hundreds of Indian-market-specific parsers, layered on top of India-specific tax logic (ITR-format capital gains, LTCG grandfathering, indexation, tax-software exports). Combined with distribution advantages — 200,000+ signups, presence in 300+ cities, deep advisor/CA/family-office relationships, and Zerodha Rainmatter (+Enam) backing — the aggregation breadth and localized compliance are far harder to replicate than the UI itself.
intel.build_prompt: Build an India-focused multi-asset portfolio management SaaS ('MProfit clone'). Core: a canonical transaction ledger supporting Stocks, Mutual Funds, Traded Bonds, F&O (equity/currency/commodity), Fixed Deposits, NPS, PMS and AIF, fed by an import engine that parses broker contract notes & back-office files, MF CAS (CAMS/NSDL), MF RTA files (CAMS/Karvy/Franklin), eNPS and PMS/AIF statements across PDF/Excel/HTML/CSV/TXT/DBF, plus an email-forwarding auto-import path. Add a market-data layer (live 15-min-delayed equity/ETF prices, daily MF NAV & bond prices, corporate actions: dividend/bonus/split/merger/demerger) and historical end-of-month valuations. Provide analytics: XIRR, absolute & annualised returns, multi-level asset allocation, and India capital-gains reports in ITR format (short/long/intra-day, LTCG grandfathering, indexation, exports for ClearTax/Winman/CompuTax). Support multiple portfolios and portfolio groups for consolidated family/client holdings, and a wealth-professional multi-tenant mode where advisors/CAs/family offices provision client logins with white-label branding and global AUM reports. Ship a React web app (MProfit Cloud) with email/password auth (reset-code flow) plus Android & iOS apps. Marketing site: Gatsby + Sanity CMS with features, pricing (separate Investor vs Wealth-Professional plans), broker-import search, reviews, referral program, and buy/login flows; integrate Freshdesk support, EmbedSocial reviews, GA/GTM, Microsoft Clarity and Facebook Pixel.
